features.name: black_king_confinement_score
features.description: Weighted 0-1 severity of black-king confinement from row flags for blockage, lack of safe moves, edge or corner placement, separation, contact, and distant opposition.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a dense monotone coordinate from sparse binary endgame flags, helping a linear/SVM margin reflect escalating confinement.

features.name: king_contact_threat_score
features.description: Normalized density of direct contact or capture-related row flags around the kings, pawn, queen square, and rook.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes several sparse contact events into a continuous threat axis for smoother margin placement.

features.name: white_king_support_score
features.description: Weighted activity and support score for the white king from contact, near-a8, checking, overlap, position, and edge-turn indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a smooth support gradient rather than several independent switches, aiding linear/SVM margins.

features.name: rook_activity_alignment_score
features.description: Rook activity and alignment score from rank, restriction, immobilization, pawn attack, queen-square control, and skewer cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an ordered rook-pressure coordinate that a linear/SVM margin can weight directly.

features.name: promotion_path_pressure_score
features.description: Promotion-path pressure around eighth-rank, a-file, queen-square, white-king-near-a8, and rook-to-a8 cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts several geometry flags into one bounded path-pressure coordinate for linear separation.

features.name: simplification_trap_pressure_score
features.description: Severity of simplification, stalemate, checking, multiple-check, and skewer-trap motifs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a rare-event severity axis so linear/SVM margins can react to tactical traps without many isolated coefficients.

features.name: rarity_weighted_tactical_density
features.description: Training-fold frequency weighted density of rare tactical t states, using only allowed frequency metadata and current row flags.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps linear/SVM margins assign stable influence to sparse motifs while keeping the feature bounded and smooth.

features.name: tri_state_position_projection
features.description: Signed projection of the non-binary descriptors: king-attack relation, pawn-distance code, and edge-turn code.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves ordinal contrast from multi-state descriptors as one nearly linear axis.

features.name: contact_support_balance
features.description: Signed balance between white-king support cues and immediate pawn or queen-square contact cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable contrast feature that a linear margin can use without inferring the subtraction from separate sparse flags.
features.formula: (np.where(wkcti == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wknck == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkovl == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkpos == 't', 1.0, 0.0)) / 4.0 - (np.where(bkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(blxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(rkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bxqsq == 't', 1.0, 0.0)) / 4.0

features.name: net_to_escape_ratio
features.description: Bounded ratio-like measure comparing containment cues with escape, capture, simplification, and stalemate resources.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms nonlinear competition between containment and release cues into a single bounded coordinate.

features.name: semantic_forcing_plan_coherence
features.description: Expert or language-model score from 0.0 to 1.0 assessing how coherent the row's forcing plan appears after reading the 36 descriptors; high when confinement, rook activity, and support cues reinforce one another.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth expert-prior coordinate for high-order motif agreement that simple additive formulas may miss.

features.name: semantic_defensive_resilience
features.description: Expert or language-model score from 0.0 to 1.0 assessing defensive resilience from escape, capture, simplification, stalemate, and checking cues in the same row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a monotone counter-pressure coordinate for complex holding resources, useful as an interpretable axis in a linear/SVM margin.
